import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment
import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierGammaGrowth
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Continuous

/-! RETURN109-F4b: actual archimedean diagonal on the exact weighted
spectral carrier, as a bounded multiplier pairing. No zero-side definition. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierArchContinuity

open MeasureTheory InnerProductSpace
open scoped InnerProduct FourierTransform ComplexConjugate
open WeilDefect.MasterRecon
open LogCarrierFourierAttachment LogCarrierGammaGrowth
noncomputable section

def gammaRatio (u : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ((Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u) / V08I.logWeight u : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorem gammaRatio_measurable : Measurable gammaRatio := by
  unfold gammaRatio
  exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp
    ((gammaBracket_measurable.comp (by fun_prop)).div
      V08I.logWeight_continuous.measurable)

theorem gammaRatio_bound (K : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ u : ℝ, |Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u)| ≤
      K * V08I.logWeight u) (u : ℝ) :
    ‖gammaRatio u‖ ≤ K := by
  rw [gammaRatio, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div,
    abs_of_pos (V08I.logWeight_pos u)]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (V08I.logWeight_pos u)).mpr (h u)

def gammaOperator (K : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ u : ℝ, |Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u)| ≤
      K * V08I.logWeight u) : V08I.FullL2 →L[ℂ] V08I.FullL2 :=
  V08I.multiplier gammaRatio gammaRatio_measurable K (gammaRatio_bound K h)

def literalArch (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) : ℂ :=
  (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) *
    ∫ r : ℝ, Zeta23.paperFT
      (neutralWindowCorrelation a (V08I.physicalInclusion a g)
        (V08I.physicalInclusion a g)) (r : ℂ) *
        (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket r : ℂ)

theorem literalArch_integrable (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (h : ∀ u : ℝ, |Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u)| ≤
      K * V08I.logWeight u) :
    Integrable (fun r : ℝ => Zeta23.paperFT
      (neutralWindowCorrelation a (V08I.physicalInclusion a g)
        (V08I.physicalInclusion a g)) (r : ℂ) *
        (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket r : ℂ)) := by
  let f := V08I.physicalInclusion a g
  let H : ℝ → ℂ := fun u => (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u) : ℂ) *
    (conj ((𝓕 f : V08I.FullL2) u) * (𝓕 f : V08I.FullL2) u)
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable H volume := by
    apply ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp
      (gammaBracket_measurable.comp (by fun_prop))).aestronglyMeasurable).mul
    exact (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (𝓕 f : V08I.FullL2)).star.mul
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (𝓕 f : V08I.FullL2))
  have hi : Integrable H := by
    apply ((V08I.logCarrier_energy_integrable a g).const_mul K).mono' hm
    filter_upwards [] with u
    dsimp [H, f]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_conj, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    simpa only [mul_assoc, pow_two] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h u)
        (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hi' := hi.congr (literal_arch_integrand_ae a f f
    (V08I.physicalInclusion_support a g) (V08I.physicalInclusion_support a g)).symm
  exact (integrable_comp_mul_left_iff _ (show -2 * Real.pi ≠ 0 by
    exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero)).mp hi'

theorem literalArch_pairing (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a)
    (K : ℝ) (h : ∀ u : ℝ, |Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u)| ≤
      K * V08I.logWeight u) :
    literalArch a g = inner ℂ (g : V08I.FullL2)
      (gammaOperator K h (g : V08I.FullL2)) := by
  unfold literalArch
  rw [literal_arch_spectral a _ _ (V08I.physicalInclusion_support a g)
    (V08I.physicalInclusion_support a g), L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [V08I.logCarrier_energy_ae a g,
    V08I.multiplier_ae gammaRatio gammaRatio_measurable K
      (gammaRatio_bound K h) (g : V08I.FullL2)] with u he hm
  change V08I.logWeight u * ‖(𝓕 (V08I.physicalInclusion a g) : V08I.FullL2) u‖^2 =
    ‖(g : V08I.FullL2) u‖^2 at he
  change gammaOperator K h (g : V08I.FullL2) u =
    gammaRatio u * (g : V08I.FullL2) u at hm
  let F : ℂ := (𝓕 (V08I.physicalInclusion a g) : V08I.FullL2) u
  let z : ℂ := (g : V08I.FullL2) u
  let G : ℝ := Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u)
  let w : ℝ := V08I.logWeight u
  have hw : w ≠ 0 := (V08I.logWeight_pos u).ne'
  have henergy : w * ‖F‖^2 = ‖z‖^2 := he
  have hreal : G * ‖F‖^2 = (G / w) * ‖z‖^2 := by
    rw [← henergy]
    field_simp [hw] <;> ring
  have hF : conj F * F = ((‖F‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.conj_mul'] <;> push_cast
  have hz : conj z * z = ((‖z‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.conj_mul']
    push_cast
  rw [hm, RCLike.inner_apply']
  change (G : ℂ) * (conj F * F) = conj z * ((↑(G / w) : ℂ) * z)
  calc
    _ = (G : ℂ) * ((‖F‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [hF]
    _ = ((G / w : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((‖z‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hreal
    _ = conj z * (((G / w : ℝ) : ℂ) * z) := by rw [← hz]; ring

theorem literalArch_continuous (a : ℝ) : Continuous (literalArch a) := by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,h⟩ := gamma_logWeight_bound
  have he : literalArch a = fun g : V08I.logCarrier a =>
      inner ℂ (g : V08I.FullL2) (gammaOperator K h (g : V08I.FullL2)) := by
    funext g
    exact literalArch_pairing a g K h
  rw [he]
  exact continuous_subtype_val.inner
    ((gammaOperator K h).continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val)

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierArchContinuity

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierArchContinuity.gammaRatio_measurable
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierArchContinuity.gammaRatio_bound
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierArchContinuity.literalArch_integrable
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierArchContinuity.literalArch_pairing
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierArchContinuity.literalArch_continuous

import WeilDefect.Arithmetic.ActualZetaFullGraphRawDivisorQuadratic
import WeilDefect.Arithmetic.ActualZetaSmoothCorrelationRegularity

/-! RETURN109-F1 staging: exact a.e.-smooth original graph core and
uniqueness of continuous extension on the actual logarithmic carrier.
This module does not assert density, the Gamma multiplier estimate,
universal graph coverage, or an unconditional closed-domain identity. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainCore

open MeasureTheory
noncomputable section

theorem smooth_graph_literature (a : ℝ)
    (h : NeutralActualZetaSourceDomain a) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ) (hc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hae : neutralWindowRepresentative a
      (neutralLogPhysical (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h).val)
        =ᵐ[volume] ψ) :
    neutralActualZetaSourceQuadratic a h =
      (Zeta23.EF.literatureRHS
        (neutralWindowCorrelation a
          (neutralLogPhysical (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h).val)
          (neutralLogPhysical (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h).val))).re := by
  apply neutralActualZetaSourceQuadratic_fullGraph_literature_of_contDiff
  exact neutralWindowCorrelation_contDiff_of_ae_smoothSecond a _ _ ψ hψ hc hae

theorem continuous_extension_unique (a : ℝ)
    (S : Set (NeutralLogHilbertCarrier a)) (hS : Dense S)
    (Q R : NeutralLogHilbertCarrier a → ℝ)
    (hQ : Continuous Q) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hcore : ∀ g ∈ S, Q g = R g) :
    ∀ g, Q g = R g := by
  have hs : S ⊆ {g | Q g = R g} := hcore
  have hc : closure S ⊆ {g | Q g = R g} :=
    closure_minimal hs (isClosed_eq hQ hR)
  intro g
  apply hc
  rw [hS.closure_eq]
  exact Set.mem_univ g

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainCore

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainCore.smooth_graph_literature
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainCore.continuous_extension_unique

import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierBoundedAnalysis
import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainCore
import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierPrimePole
import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierArchContinuity
import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierInteriorDensity
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Equiv

/-! RETURN109-F5: actual closed-domain arithmetic/graph equality.
Candidate only: imports include E and the independent F proof banks.
Arithmetic side is the literal literature RHS, not defined via signedGram.
No positivity, rigidity or additional smoothness hypothesis. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainIdentity

open MeasureTheory InnerProductSpace
open scoped InnerProduct
open WeilDefect.MasterRecon
open LogCarrierContinuous LogCarrierBoundedAnalysis LogCarrierClosedDomainCore
open LogCarrierPrimePole LogCarrierArchContinuity LogCarrierInteriorDensity
open LogCarrierGlobalEnergy
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 3000000
set_option maxRecDepth 4096

def arithmeticForm (a : ℝ) (g : NeutralLogHilbertCarrier a) : ℝ :=
  (Zeta23.EF.literatureRHS
    (neutralWindowCorrelation a (neutralLogPhysical g.val)
      (neutralLogPhysical g.val))).re

def signedForm (a : ℝ)
    (T : V08I.logCarrier a →L[ℂ] V07C.Coeff V10A.Index)
    (g : NeutralLogHilbertCarrier a) : ℝ :=
  (inner ℂ (V10B6c.signedGram T (carrierContinuousEquiv a g))
    (carrierContinuousEquiv a g)).re

def ivInteriorCore (a : ℝ) : Set (NeutralLogHilbertCarrier a) :=
  (carrierContinuousEquiv a) ⁻¹' interiorCore a

theorem ivInteriorCore_dense (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Dense (ivInteriorCore a) :=
  (interiorCore_dense a ha).preimage (carrierContinuousEquiv a).toHomeomorph.isOpenMap

theorem ivCore_window_smooth (a : ℝ) (g : NeutralLogHilbertCarrier a)
    (hg : g ∈ ivInteriorCore a) :
    ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧
      neutralWindowRepresentative a (neutralLogPhysical g.val) =ᵐ[volume] ψ := by
  rcases hg with ⟨ψ,hψ,hc,hs,hp⟩
  have he : (V08I.physicalInclusion a (carrierContinuousEquiv a g) : ℝ → ℂ) =
      (neutralLogPhysical g.val : ℝ → ℂ) := by rw [carrierContinuousEquiv_physical]
  rw [he] at hp
  refine ⟨ψ,hψ.of_le (by norm_num),hc,?_⟩
  exact (window_eq_ae a g).trans hp

theorem arithmeticForm_decompose (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : Real.exp (2*a) < (N : ℝ)) (g : NeutralLogHilbertCarrier a) :
    arithmeticForm a g =
      (poleDiagonal a g - primeFinite a N g +
        literalArch a (carrierContinuousEquiv a g)).re := by
  unfold arithmeticForm Zeta23.EF.literatureRHS
  have hphys : V08I.physicalInclusion a (carrierContinuousEquiv a g) = physical a g :=
    carrierContinuousEquiv_physical a g
  unfold literalArch
  rw [hphys]
  change (Zeta23.paperFT (neutralWindowCorrelation a (physical a g) (physical a g))
    (Complex.I/2) +
    Zeta23.paperFT (neutralWindowCorrelation a (physical a g) (physical a g))
    (-Complex.I/2) -
    (∑' n : ℕ, neutralIV085PrimeSummand
      (neutralWindowCorrelation a (physical a g) (physical a g)) n) +
    (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) * ∫ r : ℝ,
      Zeta23.paperFT (neutralWindowCorrelation a (physical a g) (physical a g)) (r : ℂ) *
      (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket r : ℂ)).re = _
  rw [poleLiteral_eq_diagonal, primeLiteral_eq_finite a N hN]

theorem arithmeticForm_continuous (a : ℝ) : Continuous (arithmeticForm a) := by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (Real.exp (2*a))
  have he : arithmeticForm a = fun g =>
      (poleDiagonal a g - primeFinite a N g +
        literalArch a (carrierContinuousEquiv a g)).re := by
    funext g
    exact arithmeticForm_decompose a N hN g
  rw [he]
  exact Complex.continuous_re.comp
    (((poleDiagonal_continuous a).sub (primeFinite_continuous a N)).add
      ((literalArch_continuous a).comp (carrierContinuousEquiv a).continuous))

theorem signedForm_continuous (a : ℝ)
    (T : V08I.logCarrier a →L[ℂ] V07C.Coeff V10A.Index) :
    Continuous (signedForm a T) :=
  Complex.continuous_re.comp
    (((V10B6c.signedGram T).continuous.comp (carrierContinuousEquiv a).continuous).inner
      (𝕜 := ℂ) (carrierContinuousEquiv a).continuous)

theorem graph_core_identity (a : ℝ) (h : NeutralActualZetaSourceDomain a)
    (hc : neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h ∈ ivInteriorCore a) :
    neutralActualZetaSourceQuadratic a h =
      arithmeticForm a (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h) := by
  obtain ⟨ψ,hψ,hcomp,hae⟩ := ivCore_window_smooth a _ hc
  exact smooth_graph_literature a h ψ hψ hcomp hae

theorem graph_signed_of_literal (a : ℝ)
    (T : V08I.logCarrier a →L[ℂ] V07C.Coeff V10A.Index)
    (hT : V10B6d.LiteralCoordinates a T) (h : NeutralActualZetaSourceDomain a) :
    neutralActualZetaSourceQuadratic a h =
      signedForm a T (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h) := by
  unfold signedForm
  rw [graph_signed_energy, V10B6c.signedGram_diagonal]
  change (∑' i : V10A.Index, (posSq a (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h) i -
    negSq a (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h) i)) =
    ‖V10B6c.projection true (T (carrierContinuousEquiv a
      (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h)))‖^2 -
    ‖V10B6c.projection false (T (carrierContinuousEquiv a
      (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h)))‖^2
  rw [← V10B6d.signed_channel_tsum (T (carrierContinuousEquiv a
    (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h)))]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro i
  rw [hT (carrierContinuousEquiv a (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h)) i] <;> rfl

theorem actual_closed_domain_identity (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ T : V08I.logCarrier a →L[ℂ] V07C.Coeff V10A.Index,
      V10B6d.LiteralCoordinates a T ∧
      (∀ g : NeutralLogHilbertCarrier a, arithmeticForm a g = signedForm a T g) ∧
      (∀ g : NeutralLogHilbertCarrier a, ∃ h : NeutralActualZetaSourceDomain a,
        neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h = g ∧
        graphCoeff a h = T (carrierContinuousEquiv a g) ∧
        neutralActualZetaSourceQuadratic a h = arithmeticForm a g) ∧
      (∀ h : NeutralActualZetaSourceDomain a,
        neutralActualZetaSourceQuadratic a h =
          arithmeticForm a (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h)) := by
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hgraph⟩ := actual_graph_receiver a ha.le
  have he : ∀ g, arithmeticForm a g = signedForm a T g := by
    apply continuous_extension_unique a (ivInteriorCore a) (ivInteriorCore_dense a ha)
      _ _ (arithmeticForm_continuous a) (signedForm_continuous a T)
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨h,hp,hcoeff,hq⟩ := hgraph g
    have hc : neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h ∈ ivInteriorCore a := hp.symm ▸ hg
    have hs := graph_core_identity a h hc
    rw [hp] at hs
    exact hs.symm.trans hq
  refine ⟨T,hT,he,?_,?_⟩
  · intro g
    obtain ⟨h,hp,hcoeff,hq⟩ := hgraph g
    exact ⟨h,hp,hcoeff,hq.trans (he g).symm⟩
  · intro h
    exact (graph_signed_of_literal a T hT h).trans
      (he (neutralActualZetaSourcePhysical a h)).symm

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainIdentity

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainIdentity.ivInteriorCore_dense

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainIdentity.graph_signed_of_literal
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierClosedDomainIdentity.actual_closed_domain_identity

import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierInteriorMollifier
import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment
import WeilDefect.MasterRecon.V08J
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space

/-! F4c4a: actual physical L2 compression of the literal window
representative. No strong convergence assumption or density claim. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierCompressionL2

open MeasureTheory FourierTransform
open scoped FourierTransform
open WeilDefect.MasterRecon
open LogCarrierDilationFourier LogCarrierInteriorMollifier
open LogCarrierFourierAttachment
noncomputable section

theorem compress_memLp (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hm : Measurable f) (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) :
    MemLp (compress s f) 2 volume := by
  have hc : Measurable (compress s f) := hm.comp (by fun_prop)
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hc.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  exact ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hf.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hf).comp_mul_left'
    (inv_ne_zero hs.ne')

def window (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) : ℝ → ℂ :=
  neutralWindowRepresentative a (V08I.physicalInclusion a g)

theorem window_measurable (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    Measurable (window a g) :=
  (V08I.physicalInclusion a g).stronglyMeasurable.measurable.indicator measurableSet_Icc

theorem window_memLp (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    MemLp (window a g) 2 volume :=
  (Lp.memLp (V08I.physicalInclusion a g)).ae_eq
    (supported_window_ae a _ (V08I.physicalInclusion_support a g)).symm

theorem window_integrable (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    Integrable (window a g) := by
  simpa [window] using neutralWindowRepresentative_twist_integrable a
    (V08I.physicalInclusion a g) 0

theorem window_zero (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) (x : ℝ)
    (hx : a < |x|) : window a g x = 0 := by
  have h : x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a := by
    intro hmem
    exact (not_le_of_gt hx) (abs_le.mpr hmem)
  simp [window, neutralWindowRepresentative, h]

def compressedL2 (a s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    V08I.FullL2 :=
  (compress_memLp s hs _ (window_measurable a g) (window_memLp a g)).toLp
    (compress s (window a g))

theorem compressedL2_ae (a s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    (compressedL2 a s hs g : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume] compress s (window a g) :=
  (compress_memLp s hs _ (window_measurable a g) (window_memLp a g)).coeFn_toLp

theorem compressedL2_integrable (a s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    Integrable (compressedL2 a s hs g : ℝ → ℂ) :=
  (compress_integrable s hs _ (window_integrable a g)).congr
    (compressedL2_ae a s hs g).symm

theorem compressedL2_support (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : 0 < s)
    (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-(s*a)) (s*a) →
      compressedL2 a s hs g x = 0 := by
  filter_upwards [compressedL2_ae a s hs g] with x hx
  intro hout
  rw [hx]
  exact compress_zero a s ha hs _ (window_zero a g) x
    (lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hout (abs_le.mp h)))

theorem compressedL2_fourier_ae (a s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    (𝓕 (compressedL2 a s hs g) : V08I.FullL2) =ᵐ[volume]
      fun u => (s : ℂ) * (𝓕 (window a g)) (s*u) := by
  filter_upwards [neutralIntegrableL2_fourier_ae (compressedL2 a s hs g)
    (compressedL2_integrable a s hs g)] with u hu
  rw [hu, Real.fourier_congr_ae (compressedL2_ae a s hs g),
    compress_fourier s hs]

theorem window_fourier_ae (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    (𝓕 (V08I.physicalInclusion a g) : V08I.FullL2) =ᵐ[volume]
      (𝓕 (window a g)) := by
  filter_upwards [neutralIntegrableL2_fourier_ae (V08I.physicalInclusion a g)
    (supported_integrable a _ (V08I.physicalInclusion_support a g))] with u hu
  rw [hu]
  exact Real.fourier_congr_ae
    (supported_window_ae a _ (V08I.physicalInclusion_support a g)).symm u

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierCompressionL2

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierCompressionL2.compressedL2_support

import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationConvergence

/-! F4c5a: bind the strong weighted dilation receiver to the actual
supported spectral carrier. Source candidate, not kernel admission. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierCompressionLift

open MeasureTheory Filter FourierTransform
open scoped Topology FourierTransform
open WeilDefect.MasterRecon
open LogCarrierCompressionL2 LogCarrierDilationEnergy
open LogCarrierDilationConvergence LogCarrierFormDensityReceivers
noncomputable section

theorem compression_support_old (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs' : s ≤ 1) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → compressedL2 a s hs g x = 0 := by
  filter_upwards [compressedL2_support a s ha hs g] with x hx
  intro hout
  apply hx
  intro hin
  apply hout
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs' ha
  exact ⟨by linarith [hin.1], by linarith [hin.2]⟩

def compression (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    V08I.logCarrier a :=
  V08J.liftPhysical a (compressedL2 a s (by linarith) g)
    (compression_support_old a s ha (by linarith) hs' g)
    (compressed_log_integrable a s hs hs' g)

theorem compression_physical (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    V08I.physicalInclusion a (compression a s ha hs hs' g) =
      compressedL2 a s (by linarith) g :=
  V08J.physicalInclusion_lift _ _ _ _

theorem compression_error (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    ‖compression a s ha hs hs' g-g‖^2 =
      ∫ u, err s (𝓕 (window a g)) u := by
  rw [V08I.logCarrier_energy, map_sub, compression_physical, FourierTransform.fourier_sub]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub
    (𝓕 (compressedL2 a s (by linarith) g) : V08I.FullL2)
    (𝓕 (V08I.physicalInclusion a g) : V08I.FullL2),
    compressedL2_fourier_ae a s (by linarith) g, window_fourier_ae a g] with u hsub hc hg
  rw [hsub, hc, hg]
  rfl

theorem compression_tendsto (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (g : V08I.logCarrier a) (s : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ n, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s n) (hs' : ∀ n, s n ≤ 1)
    (ht : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => compression a (s n) ha (hs n) (hs' n) g)
      atTop (𝓝 g) := by
  let B := ∫ x, ‖window a g x‖
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := integral_nonneg fun x => norm_nonneg _
  have hb (u : ℝ) : ‖(𝓕 (window a g)) u‖ ≤ B :=
    VectorFourier.norm_fourierIntegral_le_integral_norm
      Real.fourierChar volume (innerₗ ℝ) (window a g) u
  have he := strong_weighted_dilation (𝓕 (window a g))
    (window_fourier_continuous a g) B hB hb (window_energy_integrable a g)
    s hs hs' ht
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp he (ε^2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have h := hN n hn
  rw [← compression_error a (s n) ha (hs n) (hs' n) g,
    Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)] at h
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  by_contra hbad
  have hh : ε ≤ ‖compression a (s n) ha (hs n) (hs' n) g-g‖ :=
    le_of_not_gt hbad
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hh)
    (show 0 ≤ ‖compression a (s n) ha (hs n) (hs' n) g-g‖+ε by positivity)]

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierCompressionLift

import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationEnergy
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.DominatedConvergence

/-! F4c4c: strong weighted dilation convergence by compact/tail
splitting. General continuous bounded ordinary Fourier coordinate
with integrable logarithmic energy; no weighted-space density axiom. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationConvergence

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped Topology FourierTransform
open WeilDefect.MasterRecon
open LogCarrierDilationEnergy LogCarrierCompressionL2
noncomputable section

def err (s : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  energy (fun v => (s : ℂ)*F (s*v)-F v) u

theorem err_nonneg (s : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) : 0 ≤ err s F u :=
  energy_nonneg _ _

theorem err_le (s : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) :
    err s F u ≤ 2*dilatedEnergy s F u + 2*energy F u := by
  let z := (s : ℂ)*F (s*u)
  have h := norm_sub_le z (F u)
  have hh : ‖z-F u‖^2 ≤ 2*‖z‖^2+2*‖F u‖^2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖z‖-‖F u‖),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h) (show 0 ≤ ‖z‖+‖F u‖+‖z-F u‖ by positivity)]
  unfold err energy dilatedEnergy
  change V08I.logWeight u * ‖z-F u‖^2 ≤ _
  have hh' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (V08I.logWeight_pos u).le
  dsimp [z] at hh'
  nlinarith only [hh']

theorem err_integrable (s : ℝ) (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1)
    (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hF : Continuous F) (hE : Integrable (energy F)) :
    Integrable (err s F) := by
  have h := ((dilatedEnergy_integrable s hs hs' F hF hE).const_mul 2).add
    (hE.const_mul 2)
  apply h.mono' (show Continuous (err s F) from by unfold err energy; fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with u
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (err_nonneg s F u)]
  exact err_le s F u

theorem compact_error_tendsto (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hF : Continuous F)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hb : ∀ u, ‖F u‖ ≤ B)
    (s : ℕ → ℝ) (hs : ∀ n, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s n) (hs' : ∀ n, s n ≤ 1)
    (ht : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 1)) (R : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ u in Set.Icc (-R) R, err (s n) F u) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let μ := volume.restrict (Set.Icc (-R) R)
  have hd : Integrable (fun u => 4*B^2*V08I.logWeight u) μ :=
    (show Continuous (fun u => 4*B^2*V08I.logWeight u) from by fun_prop).integrableOn_Icc
  have h := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := μ)
    (F := fun n u => err (s n) F u) (f := fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
    (fun u => 4*B^2*V08I.logWeight u)
    (fun n => (show Continuous (err (s n) F) from by unfold err energy; fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable)
    hd
    (fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u => by
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ s n := by linarith [hs n]
      have hz : ‖(s n : ℂ)*F (s n*u)‖ ≤ B := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs0]
        calc
          _ ≤ s n * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb _) hs0
          _ ≤ B := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hB (sub_nonneg.mpr (hs' n))]
      have hn := norm_sub_le ((s n : ℂ)*F (s n*u)) (F u)
      have h2 : ‖(s n : ℂ)*F (s n*u)-F u‖ ≤ 2*B := by linarith [hb u]
      have hsq : ‖(s n : ℂ)*F (s n*u)-F u‖^2 ≤ 4*B^2 := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg ((s n : ℂ)*F (s n*u)-F u),
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h2)
            (show 0 ≤ 2*B+‖(s n : ℂ)*F (s n*u)-F u‖ by positivity)]
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (err_nonneg (s n) F u)]
      unfold err energy
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (V08I.logWeight_pos u).le
      nlinarith only [hh])
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u => by
      have hu : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => err t F u) (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (err 1 F u)) :=
        (show Continuous (fun t : ℝ => err t F u) from by unfold err energy; fun_prop).continuousAt
      have he : err 1 F u = 0 := by simp [err, energy]
      rw [he] at hu
      exact hu.comp ht)
  simpa [μ] using h

theorem tail_energy_tendsto (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hE : Integrable (energy F)) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∫ u in tail (N : ℝ), energy F u) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hanti : Antitone (fun N : ℕ => tail (N : ℝ)) := by
    intro i j hij u hu
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast hij) hu
  have h := tendsto_setIntegral_of_antitone (μ := volume) (f := energy F)
    (fun N : ℕ => tail_measurable (N : ℝ)) hanti ⟨0,hE.integrableOn⟩
  have he : (⋂ N : ℕ, tail (N : ℝ)) = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt |u|
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hN.le) (Set.mem_iInter.mp hu N)
  rw [he, integral_empty] at h
  exact h

theorem err_tail_budget (s R : ℝ) (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hF : Continuous F) (hE : Integrable (energy F)) :
    (∫ u in tail R, err s F u) ≤ 6 * ∫ u in tail (R/2), energy F u := by
  have hd := dilatedEnergy_integrable s hs hs' F hF hE
  have hh := integral_mono_ae
    ((err_integrable s hs hs' F hF hE).integrableOn : IntegrableOn (err s F) (tail R))
    (((hd.const_mul 2).add (hE.const_mul 2)).integrableOn :
      IntegrableOn (fun u => 2*dilatedEnergy s F u+2*energy F u) (tail R))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (err_le s F))
  rw [integral_add (hd.const_mul 2).integrableOn (hE.const_mul 2).integrableOn,
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at hh
  have hb := dilatedEnergy_tail s R hs hs' hR F hE
  have hm : (∫ u in tail R, energy F u) ≤ ∫ u in tail (R/2), energy F u := by
    apply integral_mono_measure
    · apply Measure.restrict_mono
      · intro u hu
        change R < |u| at hu
        change R/2 < |u|
        linarith
      · rfl
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (energy_nonneg F)
    · exact hE.integrableOn
  have hpos : 0 ≤ ∫ u in tail (R/2), energy F u :=
    integral_nonneg (energy_nonneg F)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs') hpos]

theorem strong_weighted_dilation (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hF : Continuous F)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hb : ∀ u, ‖F u‖ ≤ B) (hE : Integrable (energy F))
    (s : ℕ → ℝ) (hs : ∀ n, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s n) (hs' : ∀ n, s n ≤ 1)
    (ht : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ u, err (s n) F u) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (tail_energy_tendsto F hE)
    (ε/12) (by positivity)
  have htail : (∫ u in tail (N : ℝ), energy F u) < ε/12 := by
    have h := hN N le_rfl
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (energy_nonneg F))] at h
    exact h
  let R : ℝ := 2*(N : ℝ)
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp
    (compact_error_tendsto F hF B hB hb s hs hs' ht R) (ε/2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨M, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hc := hM n hn
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (err_nonneg (s n) F))] at hc
  have hbd := err_tail_budget (s n) R (hs n) (hs' n) hR F hF hE
  have hhalf : R/2 = (N : ℝ) := by dsimp [R]; ring
  rw [hhalf] at hbd
  have he : (Set.Icc (-R) R)ᶜ = tail R := by
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_Icc, tail, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← abs_le, not_le]
  have hsum := integral_add_compl (s := Set.Icc (-R) R) measurableSet_Icc
    (err_integrable (s n) (hs n) (hs' n) F hF hE)
  rw [he] at hsum
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (err_nonneg (s n) F))]
  linarith

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationConvergence

import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierCompressionL2
import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFormDensityReceivers
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set

/-! F4c4b: weighted dilation energy and uniform tail receiver.
This is a source candidate, not an admission of strong convergence. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationEnergy

open MeasureTheory FourierTransform Filter
open scoped FourierTransform Topology
open WeilDefect.MasterRecon
open LogCarrierCompressionL2 LogCarrierFormDensityReceivers
noncomputable section

def energy (F : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  V08I.logWeight u * ‖F u‖^2

def dilatedEnergy (s : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  V08I.logWeight u * ‖(s : ℂ) * F (s*u)‖^2

theorem energy_nonneg (F : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) : 0 ≤ energy F u :=
  mul_nonneg (V08I.logWeight_pos u).le (sq_nonneg _)

theorem dilatedEnergy_nonneg (s : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ dilatedEnergy s F u :=
  mul_nonneg (V08I.logWeight_pos u).le (sq_nonneg _)

theorem dilatedEnergy_pointwise (s : ℝ) (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1)
    (F : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) :
    dilatedEnergy s F u ≤ 2*s^2 * energy F (s*u) := by
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  have hw := logWeight_div_le_twice s (s*u) hs hs'
  rw [show s*u/s = u by field_simp [hs0.ne']] at hw
  unfold energy dilatedEnergy
  rw [norm_mul, mul_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hs0]
  calc
    _ ≤ (2 * V08I.logWeight (s*u)) * (s^2 * ‖F (s*u)‖^2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem dilatedEnergy_integrable (s : ℝ) (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1)
    (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hF : Continuous F) (hE : Integrable (energy F)) :
    Integrable (dilatedEnergy s F) := by
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  have h := (hE.comp_mul_left' hs0.ne').const_mul (2*s^2)
  apply h.mono' (show Continuous (dilatedEnergy s F) from by
    unfold dilatedEnergy
    fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with u
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (dilatedEnergy_nonneg s F u)]
  exact dilatedEnergy_pointwise s hs hs' F u

theorem dilatedEnergy_budget (s : ℝ) (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1)
    (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hE : Integrable (energy F)) :
    (∫ u, dilatedEnergy s F u) ≤ 2*s * ∫ u, energy F u := by
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ u, 2*s^2 * energy F (s*u) :=
      integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (dilatedEnergy_nonneg s F))
        ((hE.comp_mul_left' hs0.ne').const_mul (2*s^2))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (dilatedEnergy_pointwise s hs hs' F))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left,
        abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs0), smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp [hs0.ne']

def tail (R : ℝ) : Set ℝ := {u | R < |u|}

theorem tail_measurable (R : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (tail R) :=
  measurableSet_lt measurable_const continuous_abs.measurable

theorem dilatedEnergy_tail (s R : ℝ) (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hE : Integrable (energy F)) :
    (∫ u in tail R, dilatedEnergy s F u) ≤
      2*s * ∫ u in tail (R/2), energy F u := by
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  let H := (tail (R/2)).indicator (energy F)
  have hH : Integrable H := hE.integrableOn.integrable_indicator (tail_measurable _)
  rw [← integral_indicator (tail_measurable R),
    ← integral_indicator (tail_measurable (R/2))]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ u, 2*s^2 * H (s*u) := by
      apply integral_mono_of_nonneg
      · filter_upwards [] with u
        by_cases hu : u ∈ tail R <;> simp [Set.indicator, hu, dilatedEnergy_nonneg]
      · exact (hH.comp_mul_left' hs0.ne').const_mul _
      · filter_upwards [] with u
        by_cases hu : u ∈ tail R
        · have hu' : R < |u| := hu
          have ht : s*u ∈ tail (R/2) := by
            change R/2 < |s*u|
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs0]
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs) (abs_nonneg u)]
          simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hu, H, Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
          exact dilatedEnergy_pointwise s hs hs' F u
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hu]
          dsimp [H]
          by_cases ht : s*u ∈ tail (R/2)
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
            exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (energy_nonneg F _)
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, mul_zero]
    _ = _ := by
      change _ = 2*s * ∫ u, H u
      rw [integral_const_mul, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left,
        abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs0), smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp [hs0.ne']

theorem window_fourier_continuous (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    Continuous (𝓕 (window a g)) :=
  VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_continuous (L := innerₗ ℝ)
    Real.continuous_fourierChar continuous_inner (window_integrable a g)

theorem window_energy_integrable (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    Integrable (energy (𝓕 (window a g))) := by
  apply (V08I.logCarrier_energy_integrable a g).congr
  filter_upwards [window_fourier_ae a g] with u hu
  simp only [energy, hu]

theorem compressed_log_integrable (a s : ℝ) (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s)
    (hs' : s ≤ 1) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    Integrable (fun u => V08I.logWeight u *
      ‖(𝓕 (compressedL2 a s (by linarith) g) : V08I.FullL2) u‖^2) := by
  apply (dilatedEnergy_integrable s hs hs' _ (window_fourier_continuous a g)
    (window_energy_integrable a g)).congr
  filter_upwards [compressedL2_fourier_ae a s (by linarith) g] with u hu
  simp only [dilatedEnergy, hu]

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationEnergy
